item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 15/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Relatively humid easterly airstreams will affect the coast of southern China in the next few days. It will be cloudier with a few showers over the region. A cold front is expected to reach southern China midweek next week, the weather will become cool with rain over the region.

Date/Month: 16/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
